mapper.select: SELECT status FROM quant_trade_ledger_recovery WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO quant_trade_ledger_recovery (credential_id, status, lease_until, updated_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, 'READY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_trade_ledger_recovery SET status='RUNNING', lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 6 HOUR), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND status<>'COMPLETED' AND (status<>'RUNNING' OR lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
UPDATE quant_trade_ledger_recovery SET status='COMPLETED', lease_until=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE quant_trade_ledger_recovery SET status='READY', lease_until=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND status='RUNNING'
